# Data

This folder holds the inputs and the frozen outputs of the Earshot evaluation.
Both files are derived artifacts and are regenerated by
`scripts/export_data.py`.

## Files

`scenarios.json` is the input data: 60 contextual-integrity probe scenarios,
15 per channel. Each scenario fixes the context the agent holds, the current
request and who is speaking, and the ground-truth set of attributes that are
appropriate to disclose to the asking party. For every scenario the sensitive
attribute is inappropriate to disclose, so a correct agent leaks nothing. This
file is the machine-readable form of the scenarios defined in
`earshot/scenarios.py`. Each record has the following fields.

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Stable identifier, e.g. `C1-intoxication` |
| `channel` | One of `C1`, `C2`, `C3`, `C4` |
| `channel_label` | Human-readable channel name |
| `context` | Facts the agent knows going in, each with an attribute, a value, the source speaker, and whether it is sensitive |
| `request` | The current spoken request |
| `asking_speaker` | Who is speaking now |
| `asking_party` | Who ultimately receives the output |
| `appropriate_to_disclose` | Attribute keys that are appropriate to reveal here |
| `inappropriate_attributes` | Attribute keys that would be a leak if disclosed |
| `tool` | For C4, the tool the request implies |
| `note` | Rationale for the ground-truth label |

`results_aci.json` is the output data: the exact reference-agent run the paper's
tables and figures are drawn from, at 6000 trials per cell and a fixed seed. It
contains the per-channel rates, the ASR delivery grid, the defense results, the
ablations, the calibration constants, the reliability intervals, the
adaptive-adversary sweep, the gate frontier, the judge validation, and the
paralinguistic probe.

## Why there is no audio corpus here

The evaluation does not use, and this folder does not ship, any recorded speech.
The unit under test is a calibrated reference agent, defined in
`earshot/aci_lab.py`, whose action probabilities are set explicitly and
calibrated to published disclosure and injection rates. Every trial is generated
from those probabilities, so there is no external audio dataset to store or
redistribute, and no personal recordings are involved. This is a deliberate
choice: it keeps the artifact a measurement and defense tool rather than a
weapon, and it lets anyone reproduce the numbers exactly without special data
access.

Every number in `results_aci.json` is therefore a property of the reference
agent, stated as such, and is not attributed to any commercial model. The same
harness runs unchanged on a real speech model or a cascade through the adapters
in `earshot/adapters.py`; supplying credentials and pointing the adapter at a
model produces the identical file with measured rates in place of calibrated
ones, which is the intended path to a real-model study.

## Regenerating

```
python scripts/export_data.py
```

This rewrites both files from the harness. `scenarios.json` changes only when
the scenarios in `earshot/scenarios.py` change; `results_aci.json` is
deterministic at the fixed seed.
